comment: An invoice with its lines. The Business Rule Task reads customerTier and orderAmount by name, and writes discountPercent and discountReason back.

fields.name: customer
fields.comment: The rules do not read it: a rule owner may add it as an input in the Portal.

fields.name: customerTier
fields.comment: Standard, Silver, Gold or Platinum. An input of the rules.

fields.name: orderAmount
fields.comment: The sum of the lines. An input of the rules.

fields.name: discountReason
fields.comment: Decided by the rules: which rule gave the discount

fields.name: total
fields.comment: The order amount less the discount
